'''Assemblyman''' was a term used to describe [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and [[legate]]s in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Alliance Senate]]s. The term could refer to them separately or collectively.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
